title: Injective module sheaves are acyclic after forgetting to abelian sheaves
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be a ringed site, i.e. a site $\mathcal C$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] with a sheaf of rings $\mathcal O$, let $U$ be an object of $\mathcal C$, and let $I$ be an injective object [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of the abelian category of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $I_{\mathrm{ab}}$ for the underlying sheaf of abelian groups. Then $H^q(U,I_{\mathrm{ab}})=0$ for every $q>0$, where $H^q(U,-)$ is the cohomology over $U$ computed in the category $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ of abelian sheaves, the right derived functors of $\Gamma(U,-)$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology].
